clauses.reason: Record the approved stacked member rules before implementation.

updates.rationale: The member's own diff is the honest unit of selection: the parent's diff is qualified by the parent's own ready, and checks still run on the complete tree, so a small child no longer selects the whole chain. Reusing the verified synchronization record keeps one rule for which paths a member owns and one ratchet baseline, instead of a second ownership mechanism. Requiring the latest parent tip before ready and admission keeps a child from qualifying against parent work that the batch will not receive.
scope: Member opening, synchronization, readiness and status
updates.statement: workspace-open given the branch of another registered member workspace as base records that branch as the member's parent and its exact tip as the immutable base. The member's contribution and selection run from that base, excluding paths later merged from the parent by maintenance workspace-sync --parent, which records a sync of kind parent and requires the new parent tip to descend from the last incorporated one. ready and admission refuse while the open parent branch has moved past the last incorporated parent tip. status reports the parent, both tips, whether a sync is needed and the admission order.

updates.rationale: A child's merge would otherwise bring the parent's commits into the batch without the parent's own evidence or approval binding. Checking the batch history at the moment each member merges covers both an earlier invocation and earlier members of the same invocation with one rule, and the batch gate still runs on the merged commits.
scope: Batch admission, final review and delivery
updates.statement: batch-admit admits a stacked member only when its parent's latest admission in that batch, made earlier in the same invocation or before, is exactly the parent tip the member last incorporated, or that tip is already in the batch base. The admission merge carries Signetum-Parent and Signetum-Parent-Tip. Admission provenance, the final review and the delivery result name each member's parent, and cleanup applies the ordinary delivered or contained proof to every member of the chain.

clauses.reason: A parent synchronization is a third verified workspace-sync source, and the ratchet recovery names it.

updates.rationale: Parent synchronization is the same verified merge as the other two sources, so it shares the baseline and the contribution rule.
updates.statement: A member is synchronized only by a maintenance workspace-sync merge carrying both its Signetum-Sync trailer and the machine-local sync record, from the delivery branch, a batch or, for a stacked member, its parent. The ratchet baseline is the latest such source, otherwise the recorded base. A failed ratchet lists unrecorded first-parent merges and names maintenance workspace-sync, maintenance workspace-sync --batch and maintenance workspace-sync --parent as the recovery.

decisions.reason: The owner approved stacked members so one large change can be split into a chain of smaller members delivered through one batch.

boundaries: A stacked member's base is immutable; only workspace-sync --parent brings later parent work and never rewrites history.
Admission never lets a child carry unadmitted parent work into a batch.
revision.summary: A member can base on another open member's tip and is validated, admitted and reviewed as its own change in that chain.

transaction.reason: Apply the approved stacked member decisions.
